doctrine: Getting ahead is a systems problem, not motivation/time/discipline. Three core moves: eliminate constraints (not optimize around them), make 2-3 correct contrarian bets (not many safe ones), build compounding systems (work while asleep). The Protected Hour: daily 60-min uninterrupted work on a single 12-month asset; never zero on low-energy days (60% beats nothing). $10K cash reserve eliminates desperation pricing. Financial stack: Level 1 (survival/employed), Level 2 (10K reserve + 30 days funded), Level 3 (2x+ surplus deployed to assets), Level 4 (passive income exceeds burn rate = freedom). Revenue levers in order: (1) raise prices, (2) increase transaction size, (3) increase frequency, (4) new customers. AI multiplier via context-loading (not prompting); build systems where AI has full context. Distribution beats work: own audience (email, direct), build once/distribute 7x, consistency 12mo. Niche of One: intersection of two unrelated skills = non-competitive pricing power. Constraint Audit quarterly: find the one bottleneck, kill everything else. Correct Contrarian Test: identify top 3 industry truths, test where you contradict. Surface area of luck beats monk mode: external engagement (publishing, outreach, events) > internal perfection. Passion follows competence, not vice versa. Intentional friction advantage: choose hard path (cold outreach, live video, specialized niche) where others optimize for convenience. Radical accountability: you are the variable.
